name: SpectralEdge by Cotes
description: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP Kalshi 15-minute contest and signal catalog. Read latest stored model readings per series; catalog membership does not establish producer health. Read-only.
author: Cotes

tools.name: list_series
tools.title: List series
tools.description:
The crypto contest catalog: one Kalshi 15-minute series per asset.

Each row gives the `series` prefix to pass to the other tools, its `asset`, the
`active_ticker` trading now (null in the changeover between rounds), and the
`model_version` and `last_signal_at` of the newest reading stored for it. A null
`last_signal_at` means no reading has been stored for that series yet. A null
`model_version` can also mean an older reading lacks a model tag. A stale timestamp
does not establish producer health. Catalog membership does not promise signals.

Call this first when the user names an asset rather than a series, or asks which
assets are covered.

Signals are every reading the model raised, including ones that did not fire. `fired` is true on readings that cleared SpectralEdge's confidence, edge and distance-from-strike thresholds in force when they were raised; those are its calls. If the user wants a different confidence threshold (or edge range), apply theirs instead and state the threshold you applied. `side` is `up`/`down`; the venue contract settles YES on up and NO on down, so present `up` as YES and `down` as NO. `confidence` is the model probability for `side` (0-100). `entry_price_cents` is the venue quote on the same 0-100 scale. `edge_cents` is confidence minus entry price in signed probability points, not money. `outcome` is pending until the round settles.

tools.name: get_active_contest
tools.title: Get active contest
tools.description:
The round trading right now for a series prefix, with every signal raised so far.

`series` is a prefix such as KXBTC15M or KXETH15M, not a full ticker. Returns 404 in the
changeover moment between one round settling and the next opening — that is
normal, not an error; retry shortly. A series nothing is recorded for returns the
same 404 and never resolves: the `detail` says which case it is, and list_series
gives the valid prefixes, so do not retry a series it does not list.

Outcomes are `pending` here: the round has not settled. For resolved results
use list_contests.

Signals are every reading the model raised, including ones that did not fire. `fired` is true on readings that cleared SpectralEdge's confidence, edge and distance-from-strike thresholds in force when they were raised; those are its calls. If the user wants a different confidence threshold (or edge range), apply theirs instead and state the threshold you applied. `side` is `up`/`down`; the venue contract settles YES on up and NO on down, so present `up` as YES and `down` as NO. `confidence` is the model probability for `side` (0-100). `entry_price_cents` is the venue quote on the same 0-100 scale. `edge_cents` is confidence minus entry price in signed probability points, not money. `outcome` is pending until the round settles.

series.description: Series prefix, not a full ticker. One Kalshi 15-minute series per asset: KXBTC15M (BTC), KXETH15M (ETH), KXSOL15M (SOL), KXXRP15M (XRP). Required; list_series returns the current list.
series.title: Series

tools.name: list_contests
tools.title: List settled contests
tools.description:
Settled rounds for a series, newest first, with every signal already graded.

This is the tool for "how accurate has SpectralEdge been" — each signal carries a
real `outcome` of win, loss, or void, so a hit rate can be counted rather than
asserted. Live rounds are excluded because their outcomes are still pending.

`limit` defaults to 20 and caps at 100 with `fired_only`; without it a page holds
at most 10 rounds, because every round lists all of its readings, well over a
hundred each. `since` and `before` are ISO-8601 instants windowing on
`window.expires_at`, which for a 15-minute round is when it settled. An unknown
series returns an empty list, not an error.

A full page carries `next_cursor`; pass it back as `cursor` for the next older
page, and stop when a result has none.

Count outcomes over the readings you kept after thresholding, not over every
reading returned, or the rate will not describe the product's own calls.

Signals are every reading the model raised, including ones that did not fire. `fired` is true on readings that cleared SpectralEdge's confidence, edge and distance-from-strike thresholds in force when they were raised; those are its calls. If the user wants a different confidence threshold (or edge range), apply theirs instead and state the threshold you applied. `side` is `up`/`down`; the venue contract settles YES on up and NO on down, so present `up` as YES and `down` as NO. `confidence` is the model probability for `side` (0-100). `entry_price_cents` is the venue quote on the same 0-100 scale. `edge_cents` is confidence minus entry price in signed probability points, not money. `outcome` is pending until the round settles.

series.description: Series prefix, not a full ticker. One Kalshi 15-minute series per asset: KXBTC15M (BTC), KXETH15M (ETH), KXSOL15M (SOL), KXXRP15M (XRP). Required; list_series returns the current list.
series.title: Series

limit.description: How many settled rounds to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

since.description: ISO-8601 instant; only rounds whose window.expires_at is at or after it.
since.title: Since

before.description: ISO-8601 instant, inclusive on window.expires_at; only rounds that settled at or before it. To get the next page, pass `cursor` instead.
before.title: Before

fired_only.description: When true, each round lists only its readings with `fired: true` (SpectralEdge's own calls) instead of every reading. A settled round carries a reading every few seconds, so leave this false only to apply your own thresholds, and keep `limit` small when you do.
fired_only.title: Fired Only

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous list_contests result, to fetch the next older page. Pass the same series, since and fired_only with it, and not `before`.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_contest
tools.title: Get contest by ticker
tools.description:
One round by full ticker, live or settled, with its signals.

Tickers are the venue's own opaque identifiers (e.g. KXBTC15M-26AUG061600-00) and
encode a timestamp — take one from another tool's `ticker` field rather than
constructing it. Invented or truncated tickers return 404.

Signals are every reading the model raised, including ones that did not fire. `fired` is true on readings that cleared SpectralEdge's confidence, edge and distance-from-strike thresholds in force when they were raised; those are its calls. If the user wants a different confidence threshold (or edge range), apply theirs instead and state the threshold you applied. `side` is `up`/`down`; the venue contract settles YES on up and NO on down, so present `up` as YES and `down` as NO. `confidence` is the model probability for `side` (0-100). `entry_price_cents` is the venue quote on the same 0-100 scale. `edge_cents` is confidence minus entry price in signed probability points, not money. `outcome` is pending until the round settles.
